test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All red are green.

II. Some pink are green.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pink are not red.

II. All green are red.

III. Some green are red.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
**Given **Statements:

I. All red are green.

II. Some pink are green.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83a20d7b6b6156fb6482f9218dfae276c3a0751e957a79ccd2ef838c92c5f82b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pink are not red. - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation between red and pink, so it can be possible).

II. All green are red. - **False **(Because, All red are green so some green can be red only).

III. Some green are red. - **True **(Because, All red are green so some green are red it is definite).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
